name: sheet
useFor: Use for a task beside the page that keeps its context, such as editing a mailbox or reading a call's details. Use side="right" by default and side="left" for the rail on phones. Put the title in SheetHeader and the one action in SheetFooter as a full-width secondary Button; the close key and Escape dismiss it.
constraints: A sheet that opens another sheet
A sheet for a short confirmation (use Alert Dialog)
source: The Inkbox console's Chakra modal and drawer themes and its close key (src/theme/index.ts, src/components/ui/chakra-controls.tsx)
title: Sheet
description: A white panel that slides from an edge over the blurred, ink-tinted page, with the dialog's title and 36px close key.
